Artificial intelligence has placed undergraduates in a profound bind: academic policy warns that using AI on coursework may constitute cheating and be grounds for discipline, while the broader message from career services, industry, and peers is that fluency in AI tools is fast becoming a prerequisite for professional survival. Students live this contradiction daily, often without a shared vocabulary for the moral, emotional, and practical negotiations it demands.
